identity.defect: the setup server's docker-log append carries the setup_code line into the retained identity-server.log artifact, a credential the neighboring sanitizer does not recognize

findings.dispositionReason: The disclosed code is dead before the artifact is retained: stop_setup_server destroys its container in the same cleanup step, the PostgreSQL instance is throwaway, and the code's server-side lifetime is the process (ADR-0015). No usable credential survives the run. Aligning the sanitizer with a setup_code redaction pass is a cheap convention follow-up; not acceptance-blocking.

identity.source: ADR-0015 Bootstrap semantics (任何 User 存在后设置码不复存在)
identity.defect: successful initialization settles the session without advancing instanceSetup from 'uninitialized', so after sign-out the wizard renders again until the async status probe lands and remains if that probe fails, on an instance that by ADR-0015 no longer has a setup channel

findings.dispositionReason: Documented-ADR behavior breakage observable on the desktop surface: the wizard (the setup channel's UI) must not exist once any User exists; the success path is the one place the state is known synchronously. Repair: set instanceSetup='initialized' in the initialize success branch; pin with an E2E assertion that sign-out after initialization lands on the login boundary, not the wizard.
evidence: use-authentication.ts initialize: success branch calls replacePersistedCredentials + settleSession only
settleUnauthenticated fires probeSetupStatus asynchronously; a network-failed probe leaves instanceSetup at its previous value
